name: daggerhartlab/lark
description: Drupal module for exporting and importing content.

suggest.drupal/config_pages: Adds Lark's export and import tabs to config pages.
suggest.drupal/entity_embed: Embedded entities in formatted text are exported as dependencies.
suggest.drupal/metatag: Meta tags are exported and imported with their entities.
suggest.drupal/paragraphs: Paragraphs are exported and imported with their parent entities.
suggest.drupal/pathauto: Exports keep whether an alias is generated automatically.
